1. Script Overview.Summary: This ECL script defines a module named Constants, which serves as a centralized repository for static values used across the system. Its primary purpose is to provide reusable constants that can be referenced in other parts of the ECL codebase. The script addresses the business need for consistency and maintainability by centralizing frequently used values.
Functional Modules: MODULE: Encapsulates all definitions within the Constants module.
EXPORT: Makes the defined constants accessible outside the module.
1. Script Overview.Data Pipelines Overview: The script does not orchestrate any data flows or batch processes. It provides static values that can be used as inputs or parameters in other scripts.

Reasoning: Minimal volume and nesting of datasets or compound transforms.
